usage:
hergy - run a team of agents on top of herdr

Usage: hergy <command> [options]

Run a team
  up [definition]          Start a team
  down [team|worker]       Stop a team, or one of its workers
  status [team]            Show how the members and workers are doing
  apply [member...]        Apply a changed definition to a running team
  refresh <member>|--all   Restart a member
  reprompt <member>|--all  Send the bootstrap prompt again; the conversation stays
  focus <member>           Move the focus to a member's pane
  nudge <member> [text]    Push a member that has stopped to carry on
  stop <member>            Interrupt a member's current turn
  tell <member> "<text>"   Send a member a message from you or another member
  hire <name>              Add a worker

Team definitions
  new <definition>         Write a starter team definition
  ls                       List the team definitions
  show <definition>        Show the final team definition and where each value came from
  validate                 Check the settings files
  serve                    Open the web UI in a browser

Other
  cheat [--ai]             Show the cheatsheet
  version                  Show the version

Common options
  --dry                    Show what would happen, and do nothing
  --as <team>              Run the same team definition under another team name (up only)
  --team <team>            The team for apply, refresh, reprompt, hire, focus, nudge, stop and tell
  -C <dir>                 Use this directory as the project
  --lang en|ja             Language of the command line (default en); the WebUI is Japanese
  --port <port>            The port hergy serve listens on (default 8787)

Options for hire
  --purpose <purpose> --task "<task>" [--profile <profile>] [--from <member>]

Where team definitions live
  Project                  .hergy/teams/<definition>/team.yaml
  Outside the project      ~/.config/hergy/teams/<definition>/team.yaml

Details of one command: hergy <command> --help
cheat.people:
hergy cheat

First time
  hergy new myteam  Write a starter team definition (roles and profiles are picked from what is there)
  hergy validate    When it says a role or profile is not there, check how to fix team.yaml
  edit team.yaml    Write the mission, the members and the agents they run
  hergy up myteam   Start the team (--dry to only look)

Everyday commands
  Start a team                     hergy up [definition]
  Stop a team                      hergy down [team]
  Stop one worker                  hergy down <worker> (a worker of a running team)
  See how the team is doing        hergy status [team]
  Apply a changed definition       hergy apply [member...]
  Restart a member                 hergy refresh <member>
  Send the bootstrap prompt again  hergy reprompt <member>
  Move to a member's pane          hergy focus <member>
  Push a stopped member to go on   hergy nudge <member> [text]
  Interrupt a member's turn        hergy stop <member>
  Send a member a message          hergy tell <member> "<text>" [--from <member>]
  Add a worker                     hergy hire <name> --purpose X --task "..." [--from <member>]
  List the team definitions        hergy ls
  Look at a team definition        hergy show <definition>
  Check the settings               hergy validate
  Show the version                 hergy version
  Open the web UI                  hergy serve [--port <port>] (--no-open opens nothing)

After a team is stopped
  hergy down lists the git worktrees the closed panes stood in (not the project root) and this project's stashes, with the commands that remove them. hergy removes nothing, and temporary documents are not listed

When a member is waiting for permission while it starts
  The member, the tab and the pane are named, and hergy waits for the answer with no limit. Answer in that pane, and hergy submits the bootstrap prompt and goes on. Ctrl-C stops the wait

Web UI screens (hergy serve; the band at the top switches between them)
  activity  /activity (one tile per running team shows its state, diagram and member/worker counts; each tile links to the team definition and opens its apply or stop sheet)
  teams     /teams (the figure and the agreement; the files as text at /teams/yaml)
  profiles  /profiles (the picks at /profiles/assign, both files as text at /profiles/yaml)
  roles     /roles (the same)
  / opens   /activity while a team of this project is running, else /teams

What hergy hands the agents it starts
  GY_ACTOR=<herdr name> in the pane's env: the name they write into gy; hergy decides it

Where team definitions live
  Project              .hergy/teams/<definition>/team.yaml
  Outside the project  ~/.config/hergy/teams/<definition>/team.yaml

Options of each command: hergy <command> --help. All commands: hergy --help. For an agent: hergy cheat --ai

herdr.guide_member:
- To a member: read the text into a variable as below, and send the variable. Start the text with "%s".

```sh
IFS= read -r -d '' body <<'EOF'
<text>
EOF
herdr agent prompt <name> "$body"
```

  With EOF quoted, the shell runs nothing in the text: backquotes and $( ) arrive as written. Text put straight between double quotes has them run by the sending shell. Do not write a line that is only EOF in the text.
- Sending to a teammate hands them the turn. Writing in your own pane and stopping hands the turn to the human. Either way, once you hand it over, stop and wait for their message.
- While the turn is yours, do not stop until the work you were given is done. Do not promise work for after you hand the turn over (do not write "next I will move on to ..."). If there is more to do, finish it before you hand over, or ask whether to go on and wait for the answer.
- When a message reaches you, the turn is yours. Even if the sender wrote that they would go on, they are waiting. Hand them the next piece of work, or bring that work to an end.
- To the human: write in your own pane.
- For anything else: `herdr agent --help`.
- To add a teammate, use `hergy hire`, not `herdr agent start`: a teammate herdr starts directly is invisible to hergy's roster, `hergy down` and `hergy status`.
herdr.guide_worker:
- To the member that hired you: read the text into a variable as below, and send the variable. Start the text with "%s".

```sh
IFS= read -r -d '' body <<'EOF'
<text>
EOF
herdr agent prompt <name> "$body"
```

  With EOF quoted, the shell runs nothing in the text: backquotes and $( ) arrive as written. Text put straight between double quotes has them run by the sending shell. Do not write a line that is only EOF in the text.
- Sending to the member that hired you gives them back the turn. Once you send it, stop and wait for their message.
- While the turn is yours, do not stop until the work you were given is done. Do not promise work for after you hand the turn over (do not write "next I will move on to ..."). If there is more to do, finish it before you hand over, or ask whether to go on and wait for the answer.
- When a message reaches you, the turn is yours. Even if the sender wrote that they would go on, they are waiting. Hand them the next piece of work, or bring that work to an end.
- If you need to ask something before you are done, send it to the member that hired you.
- For anything else: `herdr agent --help`.
- A worker adds no teammates: reach the others with `herdr agent prompt`, and ask the member that hired you if another worker is needed.

## Spawning workers
When needed, you may spawn a worker for one of these purpose-to-profile pairs: %s
How to spawn: `%s`
The worker starts in another tab; its herdr name is "<team>-<worker>". It reports back to you (%s) when done. Worker names are lower-case ASCII and must not collide with the roster.

error.file_changed_delete: %s was changed somewhere else after this screen read it. It was not deleted

error.profiles_no_layer: %s is not there, so hergy cannot write profiles.yaml under it; make the directory and save again
error.roles_no_layer: %s is not there, so hergy cannot write roles/ under it; make the directory and save again
error.teams_no_layer: %s is not there, so hergy cannot write teams/ under it; make the directory and save again
error.bump_not_recorded: hergy cannot raise a version of %s: the launch record holds no text to compare it with. Run `hergy up` again, then run this again
error.bump_unchanged: the content of %s has not moved since the launch that read it, so there is no version to raise; change the document, then run this again
error.bump_already_raised: the version of %s was raised after the launch that read it, so hergy does not raise it again; use the current version
error.serve_no_args: hergy serve takes no positional arguments: %v; run `hergy serve` on its own
error.port_range: --port must be 0 or more and %d or less (0 lets the operating system pick a free port)
error.serve_bind: cannot listen on %s: %v; pass another port to --port
serve.no_browser: could not open a browser. Open %s yourself
serve.url: hergy serve: open this URL in a browser: %s
error.focus_no_pane: There is no pane to move the focus to. Reload the page and press again.
error.no_launch_record: team %s has no launch record; run `hergy up` again, then run this again
error.layer_flag_gone: --%s is gone; a team definition name resolves to the project's own first. Take --%s out and run it again
error.new_writes: hergy new writes into the project's .hergy/ inside a git repository, and into ~/.config/hergy/ outside one; run hergy new where you want the files
validate.global_hidden: a team definition with this name is also in the project, so this one is not used (%s)
validate.role_hidden: a role with this name is also in the project, so this one is not used (%s)
error.mission_missing: %s: no mission is written: add a one-line mission: to team.yaml
error.mission_multiline: %s: write the mission in one line (team.yaml's mission:)
validate.mission_placeholder: the mission is still the starter's example; write what this team is for, in one line
validate.old_team_agreement: %s is no longer read; a team's agreement goes in %s (rename the file)
validate.old_team_role: %s is no longer read; a role document goes in %s
validate.old_common: %s is no longer read; move its rules into a team's agreement (teams/<definition>/agreement.yaml) or a role document (roles/<role>.yaml)
error.hire_purpose_outside: %[1]s cannot hire for "%[2]s"; it may hire for: %[3]s (team.yaml workers:). Pass one of those purposes
error.profile_flag_gone: --profile is gone; the profile comes from the workers: entry in team.yaml (its from and purpose). Write the entry under workers:
error.hire_purpose_nobody: no member may hire a worker for "%s"; who may hire for what: %s. Pass one of those purposes
validate.turn_unknown_name: rule %s writes %s, and %s is neither a member of this definition nor a purpose in its workers
validate.ledger_unreadable: could not be read, so it was not checked
activity.line_waiting_human: %s has been waiting for the human for %s
activity.line_team_stuck: the team has been stuck for %s
error.edit_yaml: cannot read %s: %v. The file has not changed. Fix the YAML and save again
error.edit_not_mapping: %s is not a mapping. The file has not changed. Write it as key: value lines
error.edit_no_member: team.yaml's members: has no %s; reload the page and try again
error.edit_member_twice: team.yaml's members: already has %s; write another name
error.edit_member_required: write the member's name, role and profile
error.edit_turn_twice: team.yaml's turns: already holds %s; reload the page and try again
error.edit_no_turn: team.yaml's turns: has no %s; reload the page and try again
error.edit_shape: %s's %s cannot be rewritten on this screen. Edit the file itself
error.edit_worker_twice: team.yaml's workers: already holds %s (from: %s); reload the page and try again
error.edit_no_worker: team.yaml's workers: has no %s (from: %s); reload the page and try again
error.edit_no_profile: profiles.yaml's profiles: has no %s; reload the page and try again
error.edit_profile_twice: profiles.yaml's profiles: already holds %s; reload the page and try again
error.edit_unknown_op: unknown edit to team.yaml; reload the page and try again
error.internal_bug: hergy stopped %[1]s because of a bug in hergy. The file has not changed. %[2]s. Report this bug at https://github.com/aq2bq/hergy/issues
bug.workaround_team_yaml: open the YAML tab of the team definition (/teams/yaml) and edit the file itself
bug.workaround_role_yaml: open the YAML tab of the roles screen (/roles/yaml) and edit the file itself
bug.workaround_profiles_yaml: open the YAML tab of the profiles and edit the file itself
effect.preview.hire: The next hergy hire --purpose %s starts with this profile
effect.preview.turns_removed_member: %[1]s's prompt no longer hands the turn to %[2]s (role %[3]s)
effect.preview.turns_removed_human: %s's prompt no longer hands the turn to the human
effect.preview.turns_added_human: %s's prompt hands the turn to the human
effect.preview.human_turn_added: The human can hand the turn to %s (no prompt changes)
effect.preview.human_turn_removed: The human no longer hands the turn to %s (no prompt changes)
effect.preview.worker_removed: %[1]s's prompt no longer offers the worker %[2]s; hergy hire --purpose %[2]s is refused
effect.preview.worker_profile: %[1]s's prompt hires the worker %[2]s with a different profile
effect.preview.launch: %s is started a different way (the conversation is lost)
effect.preview.env: %s's pane environment changes (env reaches a pane only when the pane is made)
effect.handover.none_running: No team is running. The next hergy up uses this
effect.handover.nothing: A running team takes nothing up
web.error.host: this hergy serve answers requests to 127.0.0.1 and localhost only; open the URL on 127.0.0.1 or localhost
web.error.internal: the screen failed: %v; reload the page and try again
web.error.origin: a write from another page is not accepted; do it again from a screen hergy serve opened
web.error.token: this request is not accepted (it carries no token of this run). Reload the page and try again.
web.error.not_found: there is no such screen; open the activity screen (/activity) or the team definition screen (/teams)
web.error.read_only: this screen is for reading; to change something, open the team definition screen (/teams) or the profiles screen (/profiles)
web.error.title: Error
web.panel.human_hands: who the human hands the turn to
web.roles.title: Roles
web.role.title: role %s
web.profiles.title: Profiles
web.profiles.users: members and workers that use it
web.profile.title: profile %s
web.profile.unused: %s holds the same name and is not used
web.profile.env_bad: check the env rows: one has no name, or two share a name
error.project_path_empty: projects: has an empty entry. Write a directory path there, or delete the line
error.project_path_relative: projects: names %s as a relative path. Write an absolute path, or one that starts with ~/
error.project_not_listed: %s is not listed in projects: of config.yaml. Read the screen again
web.error.no_hq: This hergy serve has not read the listed projects. Start hergy serve again
web.error.project_unknown: That project is not listed in the headquarters. List it from Projects at the top of the screen
error.herdr_workspaces: herdr did not return its workspaces. Check the version of herdr
error.workspace_missing: No workspace was chosen to start in. Choose a workspace
error.project_place: Choose a team definition of a project or of the global settings
error.project_not_dir: %s is not a directory. Write the path of a project directory
web.hq.member_started: Started %s and sent the bootstrap prompt
web.hq.raise_broken: %s's team definition does not read, so a member of it cannot be started
web.hq.raise_busy: %s is starting. Start the member once that has ended
web.hq.raise_running: %s is already running. Read the screen again
web.hq.name_taken: A team named %s is already running. Start it under another name
web.hq.workspace_taken: Workspace %s already exists. Write another name
web.hq.workspace_busy: Workspace %s already has %s running (one team to a workspace)
web.hq.workspace_missing: Workspace %s is not there. Read the screen again and choose one
web.hq.path_relative: %s is a relative path. Write an absolute path, or one that starts with ~/
web.hq.path_empty: Write the path of a project directory
apply.note_worker: the worker %s starts with a different profile now; the next worker hired for it gets the change
apply.broken_fix: Fix the settings file, then check it with hergy validate
apply.broken_left: %d team(s) have a definition that does not build, so hergy cannot apply their drift
rules.ids_missing: %d rule(s) have no id from hergy yet (hergy gives them an id when it next writes)
error.workers_purpose_one: %s: the purpose %q holds a separator (, or 、). A worker has one purpose; write each purpose on its own line under workers: (the same profile may be written again)
error.herdr_no_message: herdr failed without giving a reason
web.activity.question_unread: The question could not be read from the screen
error.down_not_found: %q is neither a running team nor a worker of one; check the running teams and workers with `hergy status`
error.down_both: %q names both a team (%s) and a worker (%s); write the team's name to close the team, or the worker's herdr name to close the worker
error.worker_ambiguous: worker %q is in more than one team (%s); write team/worker or the worker's herdr name
error.worker_not_running: no running team has a worker %q; check with `hergy status`
down.would_close_tab: %s: would close the tab too (no other pane there)
down.closing_tab: %s: closing the tab too (no other pane there)
leftovers.heading_team_dry: Worktrees made while %s was running (git; what stays after the stop):
leftovers.heading_worker_dry: Worktrees made after %s was hired (git; what stays after the stop):
leftovers.heading_unrecorded: Worktrees of %s (git; hergy has no record of its start, so it cannot say when they were made):
leftovers.heading_unrecorded_dry: Worktrees of %s (git; hergy has no record of its start, so it cannot say when they were made; what stays after the stop):
leftovers.ahead_unknown: commits not in the base cannot be counted (no main and no upstream)
leftovers.check: it has uncommitted changes or commits not in the base; look at it before removing it
leftovers.stashes: this project's stashes: %d (see them with git stash list)
leftovers.note: hergy removes nothing; check what may go, then run the commands above
